texts.text:
<color=#515aee>大胆……被谨慎所磨砺……</color>
 <color=#515aee>Boldness... tempered by prudence...</color>

啊……这层楼看来是你和我一组了，奥提斯。
 Ah... Looks like it's you and me for this floor, Outis.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
感觉有点奇怪，对吧？每层楼都要跟不同的人一组行动。
 Feels a bit strange, doesn't it? Having to go around with a different group on every floor.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
不过，能在这层楼跟你搭档，我还挺高兴的。最近我们俩合作起来顺手多了，所以……
 Still, I'm glad to be partnered up with you for this floor. It's been easier for us to work together lately, so...
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
什么？不，我跟谁都不“顺手”，尤其是你们这些罪人。荒唐。
 What? No, I'm not "easy" with anyone, least of all you Sinners. Ridiculous.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
是——是是……
 Riiight...
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
喂。我得问你件事。
 Hey. I need to ask you something.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
虽然她没说是问谁，但我大概能猜到这句“喂”是冲着默尔索去的。
 Though she didn't specify who, I had a pretty good guess that the "hey" in question was directed at Meursault.

问吧。
 Ask.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你以前来过这里吗？
 Have you been here before?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
这和以实玛利之前问过的问题一模一样。而且这问题也合情合理——毕竟很难不去想，默尔索为什么对这个诡异的地方了解得如此详细，仿佛对这里了如指掌一般。
 It was the same question Ishmael had asked earlier. A reasonable one, too, as it was hard not to wonder how Meursault has so much detailed knowledge about this strange place, as though he were entirely familiar with it.

不。我以前没来过这里。
 No. I have not been in here before.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
那就解释一下，你怎么会对这个地方了解得这么清楚。
 Then explain just how you happen to know so much about this place.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
奥提斯眯起了眼睛。这通常说明她要么起了疑心，要么已经切换到了她的“审问模式”。
 Outis narrowed her eyes. That usually indicates that she's either suspicious of someone, or has already engaged her "interrogation mode."

……有人告诉过我。
 ... I was told about it.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
那我敢打赌，你的消息来源至少是西西弗百货里某个管理层级的人物。如果只是这里众多囚徒中普普通通的一个终身犯，我很怀疑他们有什么办法能联系到你。
 Then your source was at least in a managerial position within the Grand Magasin, I'd wager. If they were just another lifer like the rest of the prisoners here, I doubt they would've had the means to reach you.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
没错。
 Correct.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你与那个人是什么关系？
 What was the nature of your relationship with that individual?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
合作关系。
 The collaborative kind.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>那种……相当火热的合作关系哦。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>The kind that gets... pretty steamy.</color>

是谁在说话？
 Who said that?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>看来我的声音传过来了。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Sounds like I'm coming through.</color>

就在默尔索回答的同时……
 Just as Meursault replied...

……我猜测那就是西西弗百货的人们提到过的“声音”，此刻清晰地传了过来。若要猜测说话者的心情，我会说她带着……一丝淡淡的不悦。
 ... what I presumed to be the "Voice" the people of the Grand Magasin had mentioned began coming through with clarity. Though if I were to guess the speaker's mood, I'd say she carried... a faint note of discontent.

<color=#ebcaa2>现在似乎正是自我介绍的好时机。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Now seems to be as good a time as any to introduce myself.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>我的名字是……让娜。这就是我大发慈悲、愿意与你们分享的这个“声音”的名字。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>My name is... Jeanne. That's the name of the Voice I've so graciously chosen to share with you.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>该跟彼此道别啦，adieu。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Time to bid each other adieu.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>我知道你迫不及待想见我，ma puce，不过现在先克制一下吧。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>I know you're dying to see me, ma puce, but try to exercise some restraint for now.</color>

……她走了吗？
 ... Is she gone?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>……我走了吗？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>... Am I?</color>

……啧。又是那套熟悉的恶作剧。
 ... Tsk. A familiar mischief.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>抱歉，没忍住嘛。工作的时候能这样闹一下的机会可不多。这次是真要走啦——tchao！</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Sorry, couldn't help myself. It's not often that I get to fool around like this at work. Leaving for real now—tchao!</color>

搞什么啊，默尔索？！
 What the hell, Meursault?!
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
你所表现出的愤怒，与此事本身的重要性并不相称。解释很简单：我们的亲密关系始于我在西西弗系统任职期间。我从N公司被永久放逐后，这段关系便自然瓦解了。
 The anger you display is disproportionate to the significance of the matter at hand. The explanation is simple: our romantic intimacy began during my tenure at Sisyphe System. My permanent exile from N Corp. led to the natural dissolution of our relationship.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
抱歉。只是……很难想象你会跟……任何人有恋爱关系。
 I'm sorry. It's just that... It's hard to picture you being romantically involved with... anyone.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
我们的关系，包含了与常规意义上“恋人”所期望的并无不同的要素。
 Our relationship entailed elements that are no different from what is conventionally expected from "romantic partners."
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
我们约会过，也一起共度过时光。
 We went on dates and spent time together.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……等等，你听到了吗？听起来像是剪刀的声音。
 ... Wait, do you hear that? Sounds like a pair of scissors.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
或许值得去看看。
 It might be worth checking out.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
管理者，声音不是从这里传来的。
 This isn't where the noise is coming from, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
管理者，这不是通往商贩的路。
 This isn't the way to the vendor, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
咦，看起来它们挡住了过道。
 Huh, looks like they're blocking the way through.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<……我们要不要试着跟那些东西说说话？>
 <... Should we try talking to those things?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
打扰一下，能让我们进你们身后那家店吗？
 Excuse me, would you let us into the store behind you?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
会议！好多好多会议！
 Meeting! So much meeting!
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
所以不能进。没有位置容得下别的东西了。
 So no entry. No room for anything else.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
会议的味道是什么样的？
 What's the taste of meeting?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
咸，好咸。咸得像眼泪一样。咸得没人能咽下去。
 Salty, so salty. Salty like tears. Too salty for anyone to swallow.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
会议不会结束。吞下会议才能结束争论。可就是咽不下去。
 Meeting won't end. Swallow meeting to end debate. But can't swallow.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
……那么，这场会议是在开什么？
 ... So, what's this meeting about?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
议题一：谁是面料，谁是衬里？
 Agenda 1: Who is the outer fabric, and who is the lining?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
议题二：谁是右手，谁是左手？
 Agenda 2: Who is the right hand, and who is the left hand?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
嗯嗯，嗯嗯。好议题。两个都写进会议纪要里。
 Mmm, mmm. Good agendas. Let's write them both in the minutes.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
靠近它们可能会有危险……我们要不要晚点再回来？
 Approaching them might be dangerous... Should we come back here later?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<就这么办吧。>
 <Let's do that.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<color=#cf0000>欲望。而后，它将被披上身。</color>
 <color=#cf0000>Desire. Then it shall be donned.</color>

<这里也有一个“声音”……不过跟我们之前听到的那个不一样。>
 <There's a Voice here, too... Though it's different from the one we heard earlier.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
据让娜小姐说，每个阵营似乎都有一个……引导性的“声音”，而那实际上是一位“巨人”。这个声音大概也是属于其中一个阵营的。
 According to Miss Jeanne, it seems like each faction has a... guiding "Voice," who is, in truth, a "Giant." This voice probably belongs to one of them, too.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
一种经典的操纵手段。通过向群体灌输根深蒂固的内外群体对立心理，来强化阵营内部的凝聚力。
 A classic manipulation tactic. It bolsters solidarity within a faction by instilling its population with the entrenched in-group-versus-out-group mentality.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
啊……我看见了你的意志，并全心全意地遵从它。今天，我将再一次对自己坦诚……纵情于我的欲望之中。
 Ah... I see your will and abide by it wholeheartedly. Today, once again, I will be honest with myself... and indulge in my desires.
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
我将挺身对抗一切试图阻止我们的事物，只愿有朝一日，你的“声音”也能传到我这里来……
 I shall stand against all that seeks to stop us, that one day your Voice might reach me, too...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
……是新顾客吗？我最喜欢对第一次来这层楼的客人说这句话：你会发现，这里陈列的服饰所含的金色皮革比例，比楼下那些店铺要慷慨得多——他们只掺入微量金色皮革，就敢自称在卖含金色皮革的面料。请不要犹豫，尽管摸摸这些衣服——我相信，你那双识货的手一定能察觉出这品质上的差异。
 ... Do I hear new customers? First thing I like to tell the first-timers on our floor is this: you'll find the apparel displayed here to have a much more generous proportion of the Golden Hide than the shops below us, who only include trace amounts just so they can technically claim to be selling Golden Hide-infused fabric. Please, don't hesitate to touch the garment—I'm sure your discerning hands will notice the difference in quality.
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
你看，她的眼睛……！
 Look, her eyes...!
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
尽管这位商贩正面对着我们，可我只在她眼睛该在的位置上，看到了两个空洞的窟窿。
 Though the vendor was facing us, I only saw empty sockets where her eyes should've been.

她也……被钉在了地上。
 She's also been... nailed to the ground.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<color=#cf0000>煽起你的欲望吧……你披上得越多……你的自我便升华得越高……</color>
 <color=#cf0000>Fan your desires... The more you are donned... the higher shall your self ascend...</color>

我明白了……这些微薄的金色皮革碎片，无法满足你的欲望……此刻，无数赤红者正代替我，在西西弗百货中四处搜寻……
 I understand... These meager patches of the Golden Hide cannot sate your desires... In my stead, countless Rouges have ventured out to scour the Grand Magasin as I speak...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
这里的人真的对宗教十分狂热啊……我还以为这在都市里算是挺小众的概念呢。
 People are really rallying around religion in here... I thought it was a pretty niche concept in the City.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
你似乎还是没弄明白，这座都市里的宗教……都是有所掩藏的。
 You still don't seem to understand that the religions of the City are... veiled.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<掩藏？>
 <Veiled?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……奥提斯的目光似乎停留在什么我看不见的东西上。她没有理会我的问题，陷入了沉思。
 ... Outis's eyes seemed to be lingering on something that I couldn't see. She ignored my question, deep in thought.

她依然没有把她的“声音”低语进我耳中——我没有能听见它的信仰。是因为我被钉在了地上吗？因为我再也无法履行收集金色皮革的职责了吗？
 She still does not whisper her Voice into my ears—I do not have the faith to hear it. Is it because I am nailed to the ground? Because I can no longer fulfill my duty of gathering the Golden Hide?
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
<color=#cf0000>渴望，欲求。欲望将是你的蜕变与升华。</color>
 <color=#cf0000>Yearn and desire. Desire shall be your transformation and ascension.</color>

我不太明白这个“声音”到底是怎么运作的，但她那么渴望听见它，让我都忍不住希望它能再对她说说话。
 I don't understand how exactly this "Voice" works, but she's so desperate to hear it that it makes me wish it would speak to her again.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
她渴望听见的那个“声音”，再也不会对她说话了。
 The Voice she desires to hear will never speak to her again.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
向来不轻易下判断的默尔索，这次却出人意料地说得如此笃定。
 Meursault, who usually makes it a point never to deliver a judgment of his own, spoke with unexpected conclusiveness.

呃，你怎么能这么肯定？
 Well, how are you so sure about that?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
我知道那声音属于谁。
 I know to whom that voice belongs.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<color=#cf0000>西西弗的法衣，饱食欲望……饱食欲望……</color>
 <color=#cf0000>The vestments of Sisyphe gorge upon desire... gorge upon desire...</color>

饱食欲望，还有……啊，她又停下了……求你别停下……再跟我说说话吧，求你了……
 Upon desire, and... Ahh, she's stopped again... Please don't stop... Speak to me again, please...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
你知道？又一个知道的人？
 You do? Yet another one?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
是的。
 Yes.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
那是我母亲的声音。
 That is my mother's voice.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<color=#cf0000>西西弗……西西西西弗弗弗弗……</color>
 <color=#cf0000>Sisyphe... Siiiisssyyyypphheeeeee...</color>

那“声音”，它……它又抛弃我了。
 The Voice, it's... it's forsaken me again.
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
为什么……为什么……？！
 Why... Why...?!
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
那商贩左右扭动挣扎着，但尖钉将她牢牢地束缚在地上。
 The vendor jerks from side to side, but the nails firmly bind her to the ground.

那么……是谁对你做了这种事？
 So... Who did this to you?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
这是对我的惩罚，因为我愚蠢地让自己的心中滋生了疑虑。
 This is my punishment, for I was foolish enough to let my heart harbor doubt.
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
当我听不见她的“声音”时，我质疑了她——为此我付出了沉重的代价，也是理所应当的。
 When I was deafened to her Voice, I questioned her—and paid the price dearly, rightly so.
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
我的眼睛会看得太远，我的双腿会走得太远，去寻找那“声音”的下落……出于无穷无尽的仁慈，楼上的赤红者们把我永远固定在了这家店里。
 My eyes would seek too widely, and my legs would travel too far in search of the whereabouts of the Voice... In their bottomless kindness, the Rouges of the higher floors affixed me to this store for the rest of eternity.
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
可是我……我……
 But I... I...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
我看见她那空洞的眼窝深处，有什么东西反射出一闪而过的微光。
 I saw a short-lived glint of light reflect off something from behind the darkness of her empty eye sockets.

我必须知道，为什么那“声音”不再对我讲述新的故事了……为什么她只是一遍又一遍地重复同样的故事，永无止境……
 I must know why the Voice no longer tells me any new tales... Why she only repeats and repeats the same stories without end...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text: 这不可能是对的，对吧？这不对，这里出了什么可怕的差错……我剥取金色皮革，撕碎、吞食漆黑者，比任何人都更加勤勉……直到他们把我钉在了这里…… This can't be right, can it? This isn't right, something's terribly wrong here... I've flayed the Golden Hide, torn apart and devoured the Noirs much more diligently than anyone else ever did... until they nailed me down...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
亲爱的怪人们，我有个请求……我愿意把我剩下的每一颗眼球都给你们，作为交换……
 Dear strangers, I've a request... I'll give you every last eyeball I have left, and in return...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
……你们能帮我去一趟广播室吗？就在这层楼。这里没有别的地方能这么清晰、这么响亮地传出她的“声音”了……或许在那里，你们能找到关于那“声音”出了什么事的线索。
 ... would you go to the Public Address room for me? It's on this floor. No other place here carried her Voice with such volume and clarity... Maybe there, you'll find a clue to what happened to the Voice.
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
<对了……西西弗百货里的人没有办法知道，默尔索的母亲……已经去世了。>
 <Right... the people inside Sisyphe have no way of knowing that Meursault's mother... has already passed away.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<你能告诉他们，他们所信仰的那个“声音”其实已经——>
 <Can you tell them that the "Voice" they worship has already—>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
执行管理者，我怀疑单纯的真相，无法攻破她那由坚定信仰筑起的现实高墙。
 I doubt the plain truth will be able to breach the walls of reality her adamant faith has built, Executive Manager.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
那么……我提议我们暂且顺从她的请求？我估计完成这项任务能让我们获得不少情报和眼球。
 So... May I suggest that we comply with her request for now? I presume we have much intelligence and eyeballs to gain from undertaking this task.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<好，我们去广播室吧。>
 <Sure, let's head to the PA room.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
有什么需要缝补的吗？
 Do you need anything patched up?
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
……改衣店可真贵啊。
 ... The Alteration Shop sure is expensive.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
如今坑外来人的价格似乎到处都是常态了。
 Price gouging outsiders seems to be the norm everywhere these days.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<要是想升到下一层楼，我们又得提升尊享等级了……>
 <We're going to have to raise our Prestige Tier again if we want to rise to the next floor...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
走廊那边的那些怪物看起来挺危险的……我们要不要走别的路？
 Those monsters down the corridor look pretty dangerous... Should we go the other way?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
它们不是怪物。它们是两件套。
 They are not monsters. They are Two-piece.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
两件套？
 Two-piece?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<也许是它们的名字？或者是它们在这里的职务……？>
 <Maybe it's their name? Or their jobs in here...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
嗯。
 Mm.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
那样的话，或许我们能从它们那儿赚点眼球。或者至少问问这层楼商店的方向。
 In that case, perhaps we could earn some eyeballs from them. Or get some directions to where the shops are on this floor, at the very least.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
穿……穿穿穿穿上得越多……
 Doooonnnn... The more you are doooonnneed...
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
那存在用缓慢而拖沓的声音，喃喃低语着。
 The being drones in a slow, dragging voice.
<哇……这个好大……> huge...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
管理者，这个存在面前有一块面板。
 There is a panel before this entity, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
三楼楼层经理：无尽的旁白者。
 3F Floor Manager: Narrator of the Endless.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
它手里那个鸟笼里……好像装着什么东西。我猜是……录音带？
 There's... something inside that birdcage in their hand. I think it's an... audiotape?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
那盘录音带或许能解答那位被钉住的赤红者的疑问。
 That audiotape might be able to answer the nailed Rouge's questions.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
穿……穿穿穿穿上得越多……
 The more you are doooonnneed...
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
<听起来它想要我们的什么东西。>
 <Sounds like it wants something from us.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……它在模仿。
 ... It is mimicking.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
这隐约让人联想起广播中那“声音”所说的话。
 It is vaguely reminiscent of the words from the broadcasted Voice.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<我也注意到了。>
 <I noticed that, too.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<我们回想一下那被钉住的赤红者店里，那“声音”说过的话吧……>
 <Let's think back to what the Voice said back in the nailed Rouge's shop...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
穿……穿穿穿穿上得越多……
 The more you are doooonnneed...
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
穿……穿穿穿穿上得越多……
 The more you are doooonnneed...
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
……你的自我便升华得越……升华得越……
 ... the more shall your self become... your self become...
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
欲望……欲欲欲欲望望望望……随后……
 Desire... Desiiiiirrrrreeeeeee... Then...
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
它将被……披上……披上……
 It shall be donned... be donned...
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
西西弗的法衣……西西西西弗弗弗弗的……法法法衣衣衣……
 The vestments of Sisyphe... The vestmeeennnntsssss of... Sisypheeee...
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
饱食欲望……饱食欲欲欲望望望……
 Gorge upon desire... upon desirrreeee...
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text: 它手上悬着的鸟笼发出咔哒一声打开了。 The birdcage dangling from its hand opens with a click.

获得“广播系统录音带”。
 Obtained "PA System Audiotape."

<我觉得这不是答案……>
 <I don't think that was the answer...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
怪人们……！怪怪怪怪人人人们们们……！！！
 Strangers...! Strangerssssss...!!!
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
好大的胆子……好大大大的胆胆胆子子子……！
 The audacity... The audacityyyy...!

那堆布料无力地瘫倒在地。
 The heap of fabric collapsed limply to the ground.

一个打开的鸟笼从那堆东西底下滚了出来。
 An opened birdcage rolls out from beneath the pile.

获得“广播系统录音带”。
 Obtained "PA System Audiotape".

……广播停止了。
 ... The broadcast has stopped.
texts.speaker:
尤内斯库
 Ionesco

texts.text:
怪人们，恕我冒昧问一句……
 Strangers, if I might ask...
texts.speaker:
尤内斯库
 Ionesco

texts.text:
你们是否曾接触过那位被钉在地上、双眼被挖去的赤红者？
 Have you come in contact with the Rouge nailed to the ground and with her eyes removed?
texts.speaker:
尤内斯库
 Ionesco

texts.text:
……这跟你有什么关系？
 ... What is it to you?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
我们之中有一些人……为“声音”不再降临自己耳畔而绝望。他们开始把这份沉默归咎于广播室的管道，戳弄着它们，却是徒劳。这实在是一桩相当亵渎的事。
 There are those among us who... despair that the Voice has abandoned their ears. They have taken to condemning the pipes of the PA room for the silence, prodding them to no avail. It's all a rather profane affair.
texts.speaker:
尤内斯库
 Ionesco

texts.text:
“声音”不过是信仰的一种表现形式；我们的职责始终如一。我们只需坚定不移地剥取西西弗百货如此慷慨赐予我们的金色皮革，好让我们能够亲手将其织就、披为法衣。
 The Voice is but one manifestation of faith; our duties remain all the same. We need only unwaveringly flay the Golden Hide the Grand Magasin has so generously granted us, so that we may weave and don it ourselves as raiments.
texts.speaker:
尤内斯库
 Ionesco

texts.text:
那些渴求“声音”回应的人，并未领会这一点。“声音”存在的目的，不是赐予我们信仰，而是将不信者与心存疑虑者区分开来。
 Those who desiderate for the Voice's reply fail to grasp that concept. The Voice exists not to give us faith, but to distinguish the faithless from the doubtful.
texts.speaker:
尤内斯库
 Ionesco

texts.text:
尽管如今我们不再蒙受新故事的恩赐，但我们的“声音”很快便会回应我们的祈求。以一种前所未有的全新形态……
 Though we may not be blessed with new tales now, our "Voice" will soon return our pleas. In a new, unprecedented form...
texts.speaker:
尤内斯库
 Ionesco

texts.text:
<全新的形态……>
 <A new form...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
打扰各位的购物体验，深表歉意。祝各位消费愉快。
 Apologies for the disturbance to your shopping experience. Please, enjoy your spending.
texts.speaker:
尤内斯库
 Ionesco

texts.text:
听见我们的脚步声，商贩转过身来面向我们，动作中带着几分慌乱。
 Hearing our footsteps, the vendor turns around to face us, fumbling a little as she does so.

你、你们回来了……你们在广播室里找到了什么？找到我那些疑问的答案了吗？
 Y-you're back... What did you find there, in the PA room? Did you find the answer to my questions?
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text: 我们……找到了点什么，大概吧，不过…… We... found something, I guess, but...
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
果然……我就知道一定是有原因的！“声音”不会把她的视线从我这样虔诚的赤红者身上移开的……我可是把自己整个人生、乃至更多，都奉献给了剥取西西弗百货的金色皮革……
 Of course... I knew there had to have been a reason! The Voice wouldn't withdraw her gaze from a devout Rouge like me... Not after I've committed my entire life and more to flaying the Golden Hide off the Grand Magasin...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
哦……这是……
 Oh... this is...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
一切……都还好吗？
 Is everything... okay?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
你们把她的“声音”带给我了。
 You've brought me her Voice.
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
这么长时间以来，原来这只是一句在亘古之前说出口的话……？循环播放着……循环播放着……循环播放着……
 All this time, it was just a sentence uttered eons ago...? Playing in a loop... in a loop... in a loop...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
……不，不要啊！
 ... No, NO!
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
不，这不可能是真的。“声音”一直在守护着我。这只是对我信仰的一场考验，仅此而已……！
 No, that can't be true. The Voice watches over me. This is just a test of my faith, that's all this is...!
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
啧。真是个傻瓜。
 Tsk. What a fool.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
我为此付出了双眼？我为此让他们把我钉在了地上？！结果只换来被判处永恒的等待，等待一个永远不会到来的答案……
 I gave up my eyes for this? I let them nail me to the floor for this?! Only to be condemned to an eternity of waiting, for an answer that will never come...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
不，不……我必须再念一遍她的箴言，她的“声音”……
 No, no... I must chant her mantra again, her Voice...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text: 披……欲望……你披上得越多……你便被披披披披上得越越越多多多多…… Don... Desire... The more you are donnned... the moooorrreeee yooouuuu aarrreee dooonnnneeed...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
那商贩缓缓地蜷缩起自己，最终蜷成了胎儿的姿势。
 The vendor slowly shrinks into herself until she's curled up into a fetal position.

忽然间，一缕缕赤红色的手从她身上抽长出来，将她层层包裹进手性的薄膜之中。
 Suddenly, strands of red hands sprout from her, enclosing her under layers upon layers of chiral membrane.

什、什么……？！
 Wh-what...?!
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
那些手臂随之膨胀，交织成一张手拥抱着手的复杂网络。
 The arms swell with it, interlocking into a complex network of hands embracing hands.

像蚕茧一样将她包裹起来，把她与外界的一切故事隔绝开来。
 Enveloping her like a cocoon, insulating her from the tales of the outside.

那些被某些人称为“神”的存在……总是最先抛弃那些最不顾一切紧紧依附它们的人。
 The entities some refer to as "gods"... They tend to cast aside those who cling to them most desperately.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<……终究，真相对她来说太过沉重，难以承受。>
 <... In the end, the truth was too much for her to accept.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
这样是让我们进了店没错，可是……我不太喜欢我们是怎么走到这一步的。
 That opened the shop for us, but... I'm not sure if I like how we got here.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>当然了。你向她揭露的，是一个本不该被公之于众的真相。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Naturally. What you revealed to her is a truth that should never have come to light.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>那盘录音带里，装着赤红者们多年来一直试图埋藏的真相。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>That audiotape contains the truth the Rouges have tried to keep buried for many years.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>它揭示了一个事实：他们不过是自欺欺人地相信，有一个独一无二的“声音”，在亲自对他们每一个人耳语……</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>It reveals that they have only been deluding themselves into believing that a unique Voice personally whispered into each and every one of their ears...</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>……而他们这么多年来如此虔诚追随的那个“声音”……不过是一段循环播放的古老录音。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>... and that the Voice they have so fervently followed for so many years... was only an ancient recording playing on repeat.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>我自己也没在这儿住过，所以不能确定，不过……</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>I don't know for sure, since I've never lived here myself, but...</color>

……那盘录音带按西西弗的时间算，大概是……10年前录的。还是200年前？说不定是500年前——都无所谓了。重要的是，对里面的人来说，它感觉就是一段年代恰到好处的古老录音。 ... that audiotape must've been recorded about... 10 years ago in Sisyphe's time. Or 200? Maybe it was 500 years ago, even—it doesn't matter. What matters is that it feels like an appropriately ancient recording to those inside.

<color=#ebcaa2>它已经循环播放了很长很长时间，一轮又一轮……难怪那盘磁带都被拉伸到极限了。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>It's been playing on repeat for a long time, loop after loop... No wonder the tape's been stretched to its limits.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>奢华厅里那些高等级的赤红者，肯定早就起了疑心……</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Some of the high-tier Rouges in the Luxury Hall must've had their suspicions, I'm sure...</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>但在漆黑者屏息以待、等着抓住上风的时候，他们绝不可能公开承认，自己阵营如此虔诚追随的“声音”再也不会说出任何新的内容了——说白了，就是他们的巨人已经抛弃了他们。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>But they can't possibly say outright that the Voice their faction so fervently follows will never say anything new again—that their Giant has abandoned them, for all intents and purposes—when the Noirs are waiting with bated breath to gain the upper hand.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>不过，我相信亲爱的默尔索是不会介意如实告诉他们真相的。对吧？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Though, I'm sure dear Meursault wouldn't have any qualms telling them the truth as it is. Isn't that right?</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>房间里的大象是藏不住的。巨人消失所带来的后果已经足够明显了：西西弗百货的墙壁上出现了裂缝，离去的人也不再归来。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>There's no hiding the elephant in the room. The consequences of a Giant's disappearance are clear enough: cracks have formed in the walls of the Grand Magasin, and the departed no longer return.</color>

一直有件事想问……你们为什么把自己称作“巨人”？
 There's something I've been meaning to ask... Why do you call yourselves "Giants"?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text: 你觉得我们为什么把自己称作“巨人”呢？ Why do you think we call ourselves "Giants"?

因为你们是支撑着某种比你们自身更宏大之物的支柱。
 Because you are pillars to something greater than yourselves.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>敏锐。没错，唯一能确保西西弗百货得以延续存在的……就是我们。若没有我们扛起这整个体系的重担，它的日子就屈指可数了。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Sharp. Yes, the only things ensuring the continued existence of the Grand Magasin Sisyphe... are us. Without us shouldering the weight of this whole enterprise, its days are numbered.</color>

而且“巨人”自然不止一个。
 And there are multiple "Giants," naturally.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>当然。你以为这世上有谁能独自一人扛下这一切吗？就算真有……</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Naturally. You think there's anyone in the world who can handle this all on their own? If there were...</color>

所以怎么，西西弗百货对你们来说不过是一场戏？每一桩怪诞、每一件荒唐事，都不过是巨人们隔岸观火的一场余兴节目，事不关己？
 So what, is the Grand Magasin nothing more than a show to you? Every bizarreness, every absurdity just some entertainment for Giants to watch from the outside like it's none of your business?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>完全不是。在我们眼中，这里的每一幕光景都是……</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Not at all. In our eyes, every one of these sights is...</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>……令人作呕而又恐怖的。是的，这一切我一直都很害怕。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>... nauseating and terrifying. Yes, I've always been so afraid of it all.</color>

<害怕？>
 <Afraid?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>啊。我得走了——有件事需要我到场。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Ah. I've got to go—something I need to be there for.</color>

她又没声音了。
 She's gone quiet again.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<我觉得我们现在还上不了四楼……还有别的地方可以探索吗？>
 <I don't think we can go up to the fourth floor just yet... Do we have anywhere else to explore?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
管理者，要不我们再去看看右边的走廊？
 How about we check the corridor to the right again, Manager?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
过了这么久，再长的会议也不可能还在开着。
 No meeting, however long, could possibly still be in session after all this time.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<说得没错……我们去看看有没有变化吧。>
 <That's true... Let's see if anything's changed.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
那场会议。还在开吗？
 The meeting. Is it still underway?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
会议？还在开！没结束。
 The meeting? Still underway! Not over.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
右臂投了反对票……
 Right arm cast the dissenting vote...
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
……面料说服不了衬里。
 ... and the outer fabric couldn't convince the lining.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
……战争期间我截获并破译过不少密电，可是……
 ... I've frequently intercepted and deciphered coded messages during the War, but...
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
……无论密码多复杂，我们都能靠那种想要“隐藏”什么的固有意图，来展开破译工作。
 ... no matter how complex their ciphers were, we could rely on the inherent intent to "hide" something to start the decoding process.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<可对这两个来说……这种诡异的密语式说话方式，就是它们天生自然的交流方式啊。>
 <But for these two... this weird, coded way of speaking is just how they naturally communicate.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
或许拷问它们能提供更多机会，找出我们可以借以——
 Perhaps torturing them would yield further opportunities to identify the patterns by which we may—
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
等、等一下，奥提斯。让我再试一次。
 H-hang on, Outis. Let me try again.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
那么……这场“会议”什么时候结束？
 In that case... when will this "meeting" end?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
什么时候？
 When?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
什么时候……？
 When...?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
什么时候来着？
 When was it again?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
什么时候开始的，什么时候结束？
 When was the beginning, when is the ending?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
……管理者，你是不是也开始体会到拷问的好处了？
 ... Are you also starting to see the merits of torture, Manager?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
算你开窍了。
 Now you're getting it.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
你是不是在考虑跟我一样的选项？
 Might you be considering the same option that I am?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
或许吧。
 I might be.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
嗯。很好。看来你进步不小啊。
 Hm. Good. I see that you're making quite the strides.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<什、什么？你们俩在说什么呢？>
 <Wha... What? What are you two talking about?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
执行管理者，我们去改衣店吧。
 Let us head to the Alteration Shop, Executive Manager.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
欢迎回来，肩缝耷拉着的怪人。
 Welcome back, stranger with drooping shoulder seams.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
我一下子就能把它修好，怪人。我只需要把你外套上的缝线重新调整得松一点……
 I could fix that in no time, stranger. I need only readjust the sewing on your jacket into a slightly loosened arrangement...
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
呃……其实，我是想问能不能跟你买一把剪刀？我看到有几把看着挺锋利的……
 Um... Actually, I wanted to ask if we could purchase a pair of scissors from you? I see some that look pretty well-sharpened...
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text: 我能从你眼中看出那份想要咔嚓咔嚓的渴望。我喜欢那种眼神。 I can see the desire to go snip-snip! in your eyes. I like that look.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
剪刀我确实有。可我从你眼中看得出来，陈列出来的那些剪刀并不是你感兴趣的东西。
 I do have scissors, yes. But I can see in your eyes that the scissors on display aren't what interest you.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
没错。我们需要的那把剪刀，尺寸相当可观。
 Correct. The pair of scissors we need is of significant size.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
我手中这把剪刀，可不是我愿意轻易割舍的工具，除非你愿意用大量眼球来交换。
 The pair of scissors I wield is not a tool I am willing to part with lightly, unless you were to offer me a great many eyeballs.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
你难道没从我们上次的拜访中看出，我们手头的眼球并不宽裕吗？既然你还是提出同样的条件，那么……
 Haven't you realized from our last visit that we aren't exactly flush with eyeballs? If you're making the same proposition anyway, then...
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
……啊，我明白了。你这是在邀我们讨价还价。
 ... Ah, I see. You are inviting us to bargain.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
没错。比如说……“乐趣”也可以是一种代价。
 Correct. For example... "amusement" can be a price.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
你，那边那位。你那颗脑袋……真有意思。
 You there. That head of yours... how fascinating.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
她缓缓转向默尔索。
 She slowly turns toward Meursault.

介意让我剖开、稍微翻找一下你的脑袋吗？让我这么做，我就能给你们那把剪刀开个更好的价钱。
 Mind if I split open and dig around in your head a little bit? Let me do that, and I could give you a better deal for my pair of scissors.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text: 剖开他的脑袋？！ Split his head open?!
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
别担心，我可是整个西西弗百货里最出色的改衣师。爆开的接缝？撕裂的衬里？交给我，我都能给你缝补得完美无瑕。
 Don't you worry, I am the best alterationist in all of the Grand Magasin. Burst seams? Ripped lining? Hand it to me, and I'll sew and patch them back to flawless perfection.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
等我看完，我能把你的脑袋重新缝合，连一根线头都不会留下。怎么样？
 Once I'm done looking, I could stitch your head back up without leaving so much as a loose thread. How's that?
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
要是在外面，这种说法我看都不会看一眼就否定掉，可在西西弗内部，事件与交流的成立与否，取决的不是其物质性，而是其象征意义……
 Would've dismissed that claim without batting an eye had we been outside, but within Sisyphe, where events and communications are contingent not on their materiality but their symbolic significance...
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
管理者，这应该不成问题。
 This is unlikely to be an issue, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
她似乎只是想看看我脑袋里面的样子。
 It seems she only wants to take a look inside my head.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<好吧，那就来吧。>
 <Right, might as well.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
啊哈……原来你里面是这个样子啊。
 Aha... So that's what you look like on the inside.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
这个元素运用得真有意思。这么精细，这么挺括！简直像熨烫得笔挺的衬衫领子。
 Fascinating use of that element. So detailed and stiff! Almost like the collars of a well-ironed dress shirt.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
哦，这里是什么……？你把某种深沉而顽固的东西，整整齐齐地折好收在这个阴暗的角落里……
虽然我很好奇想看看，但不经同意就翻你的抽屉，有违改衣师的守则。我会把它好好关上的。
 Oh, what's this here...? You've neatly folded and stored something deep and stubborn in this dark corner...
As curious as I am to see, it would be against the alterationist code to rummage through your drawers without consent. I'll keep that nicely shut.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
谢谢让我看了一眼。现在坐好别动，我这就把你缝回去……
 Thanks for the peek. Now sit still; I'll sew you right back up...
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
<你还好吗？>
 <Are you okay?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
除了轻微的眩晕不适外，我没事。
 Aside from mild discomfort from faintness, I am okay.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
啊，有点晕乎乎的吗？别担心，一会儿就好了。
 Ah, feeling a bit dazed? Don't worry, it should go away in a bit.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
谢谢你。你脑袋里面……该怎么说呢？是一种我很久没体验过的兴奋感。
 Thank you. The inside of your head was... how should I put this? Exciting in a way I hadn't experienced in a long while.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
这足以抵得上我这把剪刀的眼球价钱，还绰绰有余。带着它上路吧。
 That more than makes up for the eyeball cost of my Scissors. Take it along with you on your journey, now.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
……而且……他们中有些人一直躲在里面……
 ... And... some of them have been holed up inside the whole time...
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
……好吧，我想西西弗百货现在垮掉也只是时间问题了。
 ... Right, I suppose it's only a matter of time before the Grand Magasin falls, now.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
他们本来就没多正常，现在却一天比一天更疯癫了。
 They were never sane to begin with, but now they're growing more and more deranged by the day.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
不过你觉得这是真的吗？要是他们……
 Do you think it's true, though? What if they...
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
你们怎么绕过两件套的？我们花了那么多眼球买清净，都白搭了……
 How did you get past Two-piece? So much for the eyeballs we paid for some peace and quiet...
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
谁派你们来的？你们是从哪儿来的？
 Who sent you? Where are you from?
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
呃……没人派我们来。我们就是从一楼晃悠着走进来的，如果这有关系的话……
 Uh... No one sent us. We just kinda wandered in here from the first floor, if that matters...
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
你们是从一楼来的？胡扯。你们在那儿待了多久？
 You're from the first floor? Nonsense. How long were you there?
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
我们一直待在一楼，直到上个季度结束。
 We remained on the first floor until the end of last season.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……你们只花了一个季度，就从一楼爬到了三楼？怎么做到的？
 ... It only took you a single season to climb from the first floor to the third? How?
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
呃……我们就是坐扶梯……还从洗手间那边穿行了一下，如果那也算数的话……
 Uh... We just used the escalators... We also moved around through the restroom, if that counts...
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
……洗、洗手间……？他们该不会是在说喷泉吧……？
 ... Th-the restroom...? Could they be referring to the Fount...?
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
你们确定说的是喷泉吗？就那个有马桶、有水槽，还有——
 Are you sure you're talking about the Fount? The one with toilets and a sink and—
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
对、对，就那个。你是说洗手间吧？
 Y-yeah, that. You mean a restroom, right?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
看来我们能进入喷泉这件事，对它们来说也很意外。
 Our access to the Fount seems to come as a surprise to these ones, too.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<也就是说，我们不知不觉违反了西西弗百货里的某条“常理”……>
 <Which means we've unwittingly violated one of the "common senses" within the Grand Magasin...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我们怎么可能不意外？我们又不能想跳上扶梯就跳上扶梯，也进不了喷泉。
 Why wouldn't we be surprised? We can't just jump onto the escalator whenever we want to, nor can we access the Fount.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
还记得上个季度发生的事吗？有个员工太没耐心，决定去楼上买个新包……结果连一个季度都还没过完。他们一踏上扶梯，就像气球一样炸开了。
 Remember what happened last season? One of the employees got too impatient and decided to purchase a new bag upstairs... before even a single season had passed. Burst like a balloon the moment they stepped onto the escalator.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
哦……哦，好吧……
 O... Okay...
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
各位顾客身上显然有些不寻常之处呢。那么，你们也去过我们隔壁那家赤红者的店吗？
 There's clearly something special about you, dear customers. Have you stopped by the Rouge shop next to ours too, then?
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
是的，去过。来这儿的路上顺路去的。
 Yes, we did. On the way here.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text: 你们有没有注意到那边那位商贩有什么……古怪的地方？ Did you notice anything... peculiar about the vendor there?
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
告诉我们那边发生了什么，我们就让你们以非常优惠的价格——那种通常只留给贵宾顾客的价格——在我们品牌购物。
 Tell us what happened there, and we'll allow you to purchase from our brand at very reasonable prices, normally reserved only for VIP customers.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
……用情报换折扣……这提议不算过分。
 ... A discount, in return for intelligence... Not an objectionable offer.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
奥提斯朝我瞥了一眼，请求发言的许可。我轻轻点了点头。
 Outis glanced in my direction for permission to speak. I nodded lightly.

我们到达时，发现那家赤红者店里的商贩正陷在绝望之中，听不见她信仰中那日渐消逝的“声音”。
 Upon our arrival, we found the vendor at the Rouge shop wallowing in despair, deafened to the fading Voice of her faith.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
哇哈哈哈！活该。
 Wahahaha! Serves 'er right.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
一直催促赤红者从墙上剥取金色树脂——愿它的存在神圣不可侵——的那个“声音”，最近变得越来越不稳定了，是吧？难怪他们最近这么焦躁不安。
 The Voice that's been urging the Rouges to flay the Golden Resin—hallowed be its presence—off the walls has been growing increasingly unstable, hm? No wonder they have been so agitated of late.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
好了，那……然后发生了什么？
 Okay, so... What happened then?
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
唔……然后发生了什么呢……？我的记忆突然好像出了点问题。*咳* 也不知道有什么办法能帮我恢复一下记忆……
 Hmmm... What indeed...? My memory appears to be failing me all of a sudden. *cough* I wonder what could possibly help refresh it...
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
我记得。那位商贩——
 I remember. The vendor—
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text: ——*咳咳* 那位商贩请我们去广播室，说那里能听得更清楚一些。不过，也许一个更“合理”一点的价格调整，正是唤醒我记忆所需要的东西。 —*COUGH* The vendor requested that we head to the PA Room, where the Voice sounded nearer. But perhaps an even more "reasonable" price adjustment might be just what I need to jog my memory.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
不知道……这故事接下来会怎么发展呢……？
 I wonder where the... story could go next...?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
嗯。明白了。
 Mm. I see.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
真的假的？你们真打算把我们吊在这儿不管了？
 Really? Are you seriously going to leave us on a cliffhanger?
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text: 好、好吧！我们给你们更大的折扣。快点，接下来发生了什么？ Fine, fine! We'll give you an even steeper discount. Hurry up, what happened next?
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text: 经过一番简短的搜索，我们找到了……一盘录音带。而当我们播放这盘录音带时……哦，你们绝对不会相信…… After a brief search, we came across... an AUDIOTAPE. And when we played the audiotape... oh, you wouldn't believe it...
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
然后呢……？继续说啊！
 Well...? Go on!
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
……那是一段录音，录的正是赤红者们一直以来苦苦寻找的那个“声音”。
 ... It was a recording of the Voice the Rouges have been searching for all along.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
……一段录音？哇哈哈哈！多么可悲、多么虎头蛇尾的结局啊！简直是给那群废物量身定做的！
 ... A recording? Wahahaha! What a pathetic, anticlimactic ending! Perfect for those good-for-nothings!
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text: 所以说，他们如此虔诚信奉的那个“声音”，原来不过是某个肮脏角落里，一盘转动着的破烂录音带而已。真是，那些异端们迎来了何等可悲的结局啊。 So the Voice they worshipped so fervently turned out to be no more than a ragged audiotape turning away in some squalid corner. Truly, a pitiful end to those heretics.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
哦……好温暖……
 Ooh... So warm...
texts.speaker:
着迷的漆黑者
 Enthralled Noir

texts.text:
我只想坐在这儿……沐浴在这道光里……
 I want to just sit here... and bask in this light...
texts.speaker:
着迷的漆黑者
 Enthralled Noir

texts.text:
他们是怎么了……？
 What's wrong with them...?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
最近漆黑者中表现出诡异行为的人数暴增，一个个都在自言自语地念叨着些奇怪的箴言……
 There's been a spike in Noirs exhibiting strange behaviors as of late, uttering strange mantras to themselves...
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
依我说，就是些疯癫的灵魂。除此之外，我想不出还有什么理由，能解释一个人会拒绝神圣的“声音”，让自己被另一种东西所诱惑。
 Demented souls, I say. There's no other explanation for why anyone would refuse the holy Voice and let themselves be tempted by another.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
……等等。怪人们，能帮我们把他们清除掉吗？
 ... Wait. Would you remove them for us, strangers?
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
……“清除”？你是要我们把他们除掉？
 ... "Remove," you say? You want us to eliminate them?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
就说我们是在……唔。对，对我们的产品进行一次“召回”吧。
 Let's say we're issuing a... Hm. Yes, a "recall" for our products.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
我们一直纳闷——我们到底还缺什么，才会一直被禁止加入奢华厅呢？
 We've been wondering for a while—just what is it that we lack that we're still forbidden from joining the Luxury Hall?
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
但现在我们知道了：要跻身真正奢华品牌之列，我们的产品必须极其稀有。我们缺的是……稀缺性。
 But now we know: to join the ranks of true Luxury brands, our products need to be extremely exclusive. What we lack is... scarcity.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
稀缺性？
 Scarcity?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
想买一件奢华服饰，光靠一卡车眼球可不够。这里头是有讲究的——条款、尊享等级，还有他们想从我们这儿买东西的迫切程度……
 You need more than just a truckload of eyeballs to purchase a Luxury apparel. There's a process to those things—terms and conditions, prestige, how hard they've wanted to purchase from us...
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
可我们当初没想明白这一点。我们太愚蠢了，任由自己的产品到处泛滥……如今，西西弗百货里穿我们衣服的顾客实在太多了。
 But we weren't being smart about it. We've been foolish, allowing our product to spread far and wide... And now, far too many customers wear our apparel in Sisyphe.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
你看，那边一个穿着的！那边又一个！一群自负虚荣的蠢货，就因为裹上了我们的标签，就以为自己成了什么了不起的人物。我们的整个客户群，全是些配不上穿一件奢华品牌、却妄自尊大的庸俗之辈……都怪他们，才让我们跟廉价垃圾扯上了关系！
 Look, there's one wearing! And another one, over there! Conceited, vain idiots who think they've become somebody just because they've draped themselves in our label. Our entire customer base is full of entitled plebeians unworthy to wear even a single piece of the Luxury brands... It's their fault we're associated with cheap trash!
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
不过我不明白这为什么会是个问题。卖得多有什么不好？
 I don't understand why that's a problem, though. What's wrong with making lots of sales?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
卖得多有什么不好——哦，那就是品牌的死亡啊！
 What's wrong with making— Oh, it's the death of a brand!
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
随便阿猫阿狗都能穿的衣服，可算不上什么“奢华单品”，对吧？如果我们想争取到哪怕一丁点被接纳为高级定制的机会，就必须尽量抹去自家品牌大众化的痕迹。
 Clothes any schmuck can wear doesn't exactly scream "Luxury item," does it? We need to leave as little evidence as possible of our brand's common popularity if we want even the smallest chance of being accepted as Haute-couture.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
这就是为什么我们想对产品发起一次“召回”。我们只是苦于没有合适的材料和人手才一直拖着，但现在是时候了。
 Which is why we'd like to issue a "recall" of our products. We've merely postponed it for want of suitable material and personnel, but now is the time.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text: 那些语无伦次的疯子，根本不配自称漆黑者，更别提穿我们的品牌了！帮我们做这件事吧，怪人们，我们不会让你们白忙一场。我们准备好给你们一件真正非同寻常的东西——当然，分文不取。 Those gibbering madmen don't deserve to call themselves Noirs, let alone wear our brand! Do this for us, strangers, and we'll make it worth your while. We are ready to give you something truly extraordinary—free of charge, of course.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
我得承认，这……是个诱人的提案。
 I must admit, that's... a tempting offer.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>对这家百货商店里的人来说，死亡曾经意味着被送到地下一层重新开始。死亡不过是另一场开始。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>For the people of this department store, dying used to mean being sent to B1 for a fresh start. Death was but another beginning.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>可现在……死亡是终局。他们死了？那就是没了。死亡如今，简简单单，就是终结。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>But now... death is final. They die? They're gone. Death has become, quite simply, the end.</color>

在这场模拟中被杀死之后，他们在N公司的肉身会发生什么？
 What happens to their physical bodies at N Corp. once they're killed in this simulation?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>你觉得呢？心智都被摧毁了，你还指望肉身能完好无损吗？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>What do you think? Do you expect their bodies to be intact when the mind has been obliterated?</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>不过你和你的朋友们似乎是这条规则的例外。这多半跟某个人……或者西西弗百货之外的某种东西有关。起初我以为是我已经认识的某个存在，可看起来并非如此。我还得再多查一查才能确定。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>You and your friends appear to be an exception to the rule, though. Must have something to do with someone... or something outside the Grand Magasin. At first I assumed it was an entity I was already acquainted with, but that doesn't seem to be the case. I'll have to dig a little more to be sure.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>你知道那可能是什么吗，默尔索？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Any idea what that might be, Meursault?</color>

……不知道。
 ... No.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>嗯，我就猜到你会这么说。别担心，我迟早会自己查清楚的。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Yes, had a feeling you'd say that. Don't fret, it's only a matter of time before I figure things out myself.</color>

呼……做得好。我早就看那些满大街都跟工作服似的我们家品牌不顺眼了。
 Whew... Good work. I was getting sick of seeing our brand splashed all over like a street uniform.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
我们向来很不情愿打折，不过……你们现在是我们的贵宾了，贵宾自然有优惠。
 We're quite averse to giving discounts, but... you're our VIPs now, and VIPs get deals.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
那么，怪人们……你们打算继续往更高的楼层爬吗？
 So, strangers... are you planning to continue your climb to higher floors?
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
嗯，正有此意。
 Yep, that's the idea.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
带上这个吧。
 Take this with you.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
这是什么？
 What is this?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
一份品鉴证书，证明你们为漆黑者的事业做出了巨大贡献。就当是对你们带来赤红者消息、协助我们完成召回的报酬吧。
 An Authenticity Certificate, proof of your great contribution to the Noirs' cause. Consider it recompense for bringing the news about the Rouges and assisting us with the recall.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
把它出示给任何一位漆黑者，他们都会像我们一样殷勤款待你们——那种奢华的款待。
 Present it to any other Noir, and they will extend to you the same hospitality we showed you—the lavish kind.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
你们能不能把打听到的、关于那位再也听不见自己“声音”的赤红者的事，转告给楼上的漆黑者？
 Would you pass along to the Noirs of the higher floor what you learned of the Rouge who no longer hears her Voice?
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
还有，要是你们旅途中又碰到什么有用的情报，能不能回来告诉我们一声？
 And if you ever come across any more useful information in your journey, would you return to us and share them?
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
你们是唯一能在楼层间自由往来的人——所以也只有你们能完成这个任务。
 You are the only ones who can traverse between floors freely—so you're also the only ones who can carry out that task.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
<听起来挺简单的……反正我们本来也是想往楼上走。>
 <Seems simple enough... We're trying to go upstairs, anyway.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
是，执行管理者。遵命。
 Yes, Executive Manager. As you wish.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
哦、哦好。
 O-okay.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
谢谢。你们让我们感激不尽。
 Thank you. You have our gratitude.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
我们完全依赖你们提供的情报——正如我们所说，我们没法自由往来于楼层之间。
 We're relying entirely on the information you provide us—as we've said, we're not free to travel between floors.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
<看来我们现在算是赢得漆黑者的信任了……？>
 <I guess we've won the Noirs over now...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
是啊。不过这到底是不是件好事，我可说不准。
 Yeah. Not sure if that's a good thing, though.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
你们可以经由下方的走廊抵达广播室……求你们了，我需要那“声音”……
 You will be able to reach the Public Address Room via the corridor below... Please, I need the Voice...
texts.speaker:
不动者
 L'Inamovible

texts.text:
走吧，我们该动身了。这些废物这会儿正拖累着我们的品牌形象呢。
 Come on, let's get moving. These bums are dragging our brand image down as we speak.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
等你们办完召回再回来找我们，我保证给你们一次千载难逢的折扣。
 Come back after you're done issuing recalls, and I promise you we'll give you a once-in-a-lifetime discount.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
这可是极为独家的贵宾价……所以别到处跟阿猫阿狗说。
 These are highly exclusive VIP prices... So don't go telling any other schmuck about it.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
这可是极为独家的贵宾价……所以别到处跟阿猫阿狗说。
 These are highly exclusive VIP prices... So don't go telling any other schmuck about it.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
<color=#E1B643>暂且随她去吧。这孩子心中的伤口，如今才刚刚结上痂。她需要时间。</color>
 <color=#E1B643>Leave her be for now. Only now have scabs grown over the wound in this child's heart. She'll need time.</color>

这个声音……是谁？听起来不像让娜小姐。
 This voice... Who is this? She doesn't sound like Miss Jeanne.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
默尔索移开了视线，表情变得僵硬。
 Meursault looked away, his expression hardened.

喂……这又是你认识的另一个声音吗？
 Hey... Is this another voice you recognize?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
……是阳光。
 ... It's the sunshine.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
我说不清那是默尔索脸上罕见的烦躁神色，还是她从“阳光”这个词里察觉到了什么弦外之音，但……
 I wasn't sure if it was the rare look of annoyance on Meursault's face, or if she caught some hint in the word "sunshine," but...

……奥提斯没有再追问，从那蚕茧旁退开了。
 ... Outis backed away from the cocoon without asking further.

我觉得我们现在还不能跟她说话。
 I don't think we can talk to her yet.

她正因恐惧和惊慌而颤抖着。我觉得她现在的状态，没办法接收这盘录音带……
 She's trembling in fear and alarm. I don't think she's in any state to receive the audiotape...

或许这跟我们在广播室里听到的“他们之中的一个”那种说法有关。
 Maybe this has something to do with "one of them" talk we heard in the PA room.

它已经不再闪烁、不再舞动了。
 It doesn't twinkle or dance anymore.

地上摊着一滩血肉。看起来像一个瘪掉的气球。
 A slough of flesh is splayed on the ground. Looks like a popped balloon.

楼层经理再也不会说话了。
 The Floor Manager speaks no more.

听……那颤音……那颤音……
 Hear... the warbling... The warbling...

……还满是会议。
 ... Still full of meeting.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
打扰会议，你就会变成两个。
 Disturb the meeting, and you'll become two.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
会议进行中。
 Meeting underway.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
重要议题。非常重要。
 Important agenda. Very important.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
我们是一个，还是两个？
 Are we one, or are we two?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
决议未通过。一票对一票。需要多数票才能通过。
 Resolution killed. Vote was one to one. Majority vote needed to pass.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
我就直说了吧……不如我们现在就帮你们把结论定下来？
 Let me cut to the chase... How about we draw that conclusion for you right now?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
由观众决定？
 The audience will decide?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
没有这种先例！怎么做？
 No such precedent! How?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
……就像这样。
 ... Like this.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
辛克莱顿了顿，回头看了看默尔索和我。
 Sinclair paused, glancing back at Meursault and me.

奥提斯回以一个鼓励的点头。
 Outis returned an encouraging nod.

正如改衣师所说，这剪刀磨得很锋利。
 Like the alterationist said, the scissors were well-sharpened.
咔嚓咔嚓，那些纠缠的丝线几乎没怎么抵抗就断开了…… Snip snip, the tangled strings fall apart with little resistance...

哦？
 Oh?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
哦？
 Oh?
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
你在这儿啊。我还以为你一直都在我里面呢。
 There you are. Thought you were inside of me all along.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
你在那儿啊。我还以为你一直都在我外面呢。
 Here you are. Thought you were outside of me all along.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
那这样一来，你们现在可以休会了吧？
 Which means you can adjourn the meeting now, right?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
议题清空。议题终于办完了。
 Agenda empty. Agenda finally done.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
我现在想起来了。我们是两个。我们一直都是两个。
 I remember now. We were two. We were always two.
texts.speaker:
两件套
 Two-piece

texts.text:
一个，变成了两个。变成两个的那个，再也不动了。
 One has become two. The one who has become two stirs no longer.

看起来和一楼那些血肉服装很像。八成也是同样的材质做的……不过这些设计有种说不上来的精致感。
 Looks similar to the fleshy outfits from the first floor. Probably made from the same material, too... But something about these designs feels more refined, so to speak.

[坠落的微分 第2辑：“西格尔”
这件装置艺术的灵感来自一具人体模特从西西弗百货高处坠落的场景。其意象唤起的是时间坠落不息的连续性。]
 [Differential of Falling Series 2: "Siegel"
This installation was inspired by a Mannequin's fall through the Grand Magasin. The imagery evokes the falling continuity of time.]

……尽管已经见过不少与这件装置艺术相似的东西，这种血腥艺术依然让人无法理解。
 ... Despite having seen plenty of things reminiscent of this installation, gory art remains just as incomprehensible.

[坠落的微分 第3辑：“斯托克曼”
这件装置艺术的灵感来自一具人体模特从西西弗百货高处坠落的场景。其意象唤起的是时间坠落不息的连续性。
相较于第1辑装置，这件雕塑的尺寸更小。]
 [Differential of Falling Series 3: "Stockmann"
This installation was inspired by a Mannequin's fall through the Grand Magasin. The imagery evokes the falling continuity of time.
Sculpted in a smaller size relative to the Series 1 installation.]

我实在不明白，怎么会有人把这种东西摆出来展示，还美其名曰艺术。
 I fail to see why anyone would put something like this on display and call it art.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
不过那位痴迷于如此怪诞美学的女人，会怎么看这件东西，我可说不好……
 Though I cannot say what that woman, with her fixation on such bizarre aesthetics, might have thought of it...
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<唔……你说得对。要是良秀在这儿，她会……>
 <Hmm... you're right. If Ryōshū were here, she'd...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
良秀……我觉得她会说这是D.R.A.B.。
 Ryōshū... I think she'd call this D.R.A.B.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<土气？哦……D.R.A.B.，是首字母缩写吗？>
 <Drab? Oh... D.R.A.B. Acronym, huh?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
对。“沉闷（Dull）。重复（Repetitive）。毫无艺术性（Artless）。无聊（Boring）。”……她大概就是这么看这一切的吧。
 Yup. "Dull. Repetitive. Artless. Boring." ... That's probably how she'd see all of this.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
这已经不只是单纯的解读了……你简直是跟她建立了真正的心灵感应。
 This is more than mere interpretation... You might as well be forming a genuine psychic link with her.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
我忽然意识到，辛克莱的进步一天比一天更让人心里发毛。
 It occurred to me that Sinclair's progress was becoming more frightening by the day.

一条看起来是金属制成的项链摆在展示台上。
 A necklace that appears to be made of metal is on display.

一台收银机。里面似乎什么都不剩了。
 A cash register. There doesn't seem to be anything left inside.

一具没有装饰的人体模特躯干。
 An unadorned mannequin torso.

一件染着独特图案的T恤。从价格标签来看，比大多数其他衣服都便宜。
 A T-shirt dyed in a unique pattern. Judging by the price tag, it seems cheaper than most of the other clothing.

[勒普雷齐当特67年签名系列。
这是赤红者独特选材与悠久传统的凝练之作，这种别具一格却又恰如其分的融合，在这个变革的时代为其确立了独一无二的身份。——具体价格请咨询客服代表。]
 [Le Président 67' Signature Collection.
An encapsulation of Le Rouge's unique choice of material and bygone heritages, this exceptional blending has established a unique yet fitting identity for itself in the age of change. - Please enquire a customer representative for more information on its price.]

这是一台收银机。伸手进抽屉里摸了摸，看看还有没有剩下什么……摸出了几颗滚落在角落里的眼球。
 It's a cash register. Reaching into its drawer to see if there's anything left... yields some eyeballs that were rolling around in its corner.

收获不错，执行管理者。拿上吧——我们应该尽量多找、多留下这些东西才对。
 Not a bad get, Executive Manager. Take it—it should do us good to find and keep as many of these as we can.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<呃……你确定吗？>
 <Uh... Are you sure?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
等、等等，这不就是明目张胆的盗窃吗？
 W-wait, isn't this just straight-up thievery?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
这个策略更准确的说法应该是“战地征用战术”。
 A more accurate designation for this strategy would be "field requisition tactics."
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>我看啊，这个策略大概在这儿会被叫做“盗窃”。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>I don't know, this strategy probably falls under the designation we call "larceny" here.</color>

……*咳*
 ... *cough*
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<等等，我们不能从收银机里拿眼球？那我们杀的那些人体模特呢——我是说，那些被我们“请出去”的？>
 <Wait, we're not allowed to take eyeballs from cash registers? What about all those Mannequins we kill—I mean, "helped to the exit"?>
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>呼呼，你是说那算“恶意毁坏财物”吗？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Fuhu, you mean "criminal damage to property"?</color>

管理者，西西弗百货并没有针对此类行为的罪名认定或法律惩处框架。
 There are no criminal designations or legal framework for punishment for such behavior in the Grand Magasin, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<color=#ebcaa2>*嗤* 你真没意思。干嘛要告诉他们这个？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>*scoff* You're no fun. Why would you tell them that?</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>拿上吧。反正它本来也不属于任何人。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Take it. It doesn't belong to anyone, anyway.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>还有你……</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>And you...</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>还是没搞懂什么叫开玩笑，是吧？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Still haven't figured out jokes, have you?</color>

……“就地征用”了几颗眼球而已。
 ..."Field requisitioned" some eyeballs.
没有那么需要这些东西。 Don't need these that badly.

什么都不剩了。
 There isn't anything left.

下方有一段说明文字：[以活体组织新鲜熔化的脂肪组织处理、涂覆而成。触摸它，感受那如玻璃般光滑、如珐琅般的表面。]
 There's a caption below that says the following: [Treated and coated with fresh-melted fat tissue from a living subject. Touch it and feel the glassy, enamelistic surface.]

获得了几颗掉进沙发缝隙里的眼球。
 Obtained some eyeballs that fell through the cracks in the couch.

一件大胆采用皱缩皮肤作为材质的服装。价格标签上只写着“肌少症体重”。
 Apparel with striking use of wrinkled skin as its material. The price tag simply says "Sarcopenic Weight".

标签上写着[季节性服饰]，但完全看不出这些衣服究竟是为哪个季节准备的……
 The label calls it [Seasonal Apparel], but it's unclear which season they could possibly be for...

一团团面团粘在一起，结成了更大的一团。说不清这是要被单独欣赏的艺术品本身，还是某件艺术品的底座。
 Lumps of dough gummed together into a bigger lump. Not sure if it's an objet to be admired in itself, or a stand for one.

[68年签名系列。对贯穿67年系列的复古主义哲学，做出了毫不含糊的拒绝，同时也是对赤红者精髓所在的解构特质的一次完满呈现。]
 [68' Signature Collection. An unequivocal rejection of the revivalist philosophy that underlined the 67' Collection, and a consummation of the deconstructive quality that is quintessentially Rouge.]

一张厚实柔软的沙发，可以让疲惫的双脚歇一歇，说不定还能顺便欣赏一下那边的装置艺术。
 A plush couch to rest one's weary feet and, possibly, enjoy that installation over there.

[坠落的微分 第1辑：“辛西娅”
这件装置艺术描绘的是辛西娅坠落的场景，她是第一个在西西弗百货坠落的人体模特。作为该系列中唯一的大型装置，它与系列中其余作品的不同之处在于，它是唯一以精雕细琢的细节，描绘出她坠落起始那一瞬间的作品。]
 [Differential of Falling Series 1: "Cynthia"
This installation depicts the fall of Cynthia, the first Mannequin to fall in the Grand Magasin. The only large-scale installation in the series, it sets itself apart from the rest of the series by being the only piece to depict the precise moment her fall began in painstaking detail.]

这让我想起了我们之前在环指父辈画廊里看到的那些东西。
 Reminds me of the things we saw back at the Ring Nursefather's gallery.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text: <我就是……我就是不明白这些东西艺术在哪儿了。> artistic about these things.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
啊。不过那边好像有个东西躺着。那也是……艺术品的一部分吗？
 Ah. There's something lying over there, though. Is that part of the... artwork too?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<我看不是。默尔索，能帮我捡一下那个吗？>
 <I don't think so. Can you grab that for me, Meursault?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
在可及范围内。这些似乎是眼球。我会暂时替你保管。
 It is within reach. These appear to be eyeballs. I will hold on to it for the time being.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
标签上写着[过季商品]。
 The label says [Off-Season Items].

几件用看起来像骨头的东西装饰起来的衣物。
 Articles of clothing adorned with what appear to be bones.

[“禽鸟”实验系列。]
下方说明写道，这件作品的灵感来自一只鸟。它从头到脚都涂着厚厚一层羽毛——他们到底是从哪儿弄来这么多羽毛的？
 ["Les Oiseaux" Experimental Collection.]
The caption below reads that it was inspired by a bird. It is plastered from top to bottom with a thick coating of feathers—where did they even get the feathers?

这扇门上挂着一层厚重的帘幕。似乎进不去。
 There's a heavy curtain draped over this door. Can't seem to enter.
[미사용] 두툼한 커튼 사이로 할로겐등이 나와있다. 온기는 전혀 느껴지지 않는다.
[미사용] 붉은 실에 재봉틀들이 묶인 채 매달려있다.

一条从某人——或者某物——身上分离出来的巨大手臂。
 A gargantuan arm separated from somebody. Or something.

一顶勉强能被称作“普通”的宽檐帽。
 A brimmed hat that one might dare call "average."

各色丝线沿着这面墙排列着。
 A sundry of colorful threads line this wall.

刃口非常锋利。与其说是剪刀刃，倒更像是镰刀刃。
 The edge is very sharp. Almost like a scythe's edge rather than a scissor blade's.
[미사용] 많이 쓰였는지 듬성듬성 차있다. 건너편 벽에 남은 실들이 많으니 모자랄 일은 없어보인다.
[미사용] 무딘 가위다. 무언갈 자르기보단, 찢어낼 것 같다.

一把生锈的剪刀。看样子已经有一阵子没用过了。
 A rusty pair of scissors. These haven't been used in a while.

另一侧被一层厚厚的布料遮挡住了。那里有什么东西在闪烁。
 The other side is hidden behind a thick layer of fabric. There's something twinkling there.

另一侧被一层厚厚的布料遮挡住了。
 The other side is hidden behind a thick layer of fabric.

这里有很多孔洞。可能是用来插东西的。
 There are numerous holes here. Possibly for plugging something in.

这些已经有一阵子没连接过了。插口里全是灰尘。
 These haven't been connected in a while. The sockets are full of dust.

每个孔洞上都贴着一张标签。标签上原本写了些什么，但如今已经褪色到无法辨认了。
 Each hole has a tag taped on top of it. There used to be something written on the tags, but now they're faded and illegible.

什么都听不见。
 Don't hear anything.

听起来像是远处人群的嘈杂声。
 Sounds like the hubbub of a distant crowd.

很安静。一定是听错了别的什么声音。
 It's quiet. Must've mistaken some other sound.

这个装置看起来像是通风扇。
里面积了好多灰……肯定坏了很久了。
 This device looks like a ventilation fan. 
It's so dusty inside... Must have been out of order for a while.
[미사용] 아래쪽 넓은 구멍 깊숙이 눈알이 하나 끼어있다. 아슬아슬하게 손을 집어넣어 꺼낼 수 있을 것 같다.
[미사용] 버튼이 따로 없는 걸로 봐서, 여기서 작동시킬 수는 없어보인다. 작동시킨다 한들 먼지를 뒤집어쓰겠지…

那条长缝里……积了一层灰尘。
 There's a dusting of... dust inside the long gap.
[미사용] 틈새와 구멍을 모두 살펴봤지만 건질 만한 건 보이지 않는다.

坠落的瓦砾堵住了去路。没法翻过去也没法绕过去。
 Fallen debris is blocking the way. There's no way over or around it.

不知道有什么游戏会用这种骰子。
 Don't know any games that use these dice.

杂乱的点数和字母毫无规律地散布在它的各面上。
 Random pips and letters are scattered on its sides without rhyme or reason.

连一英寸都推不动……肯定比看起来沉得多。
 Can't even move it an inch... Must be heavier than it looks.

好奇怪的一颗骰子。它怎么会出现在广播室里……？
 What a strange-looking die. What is it doing in a PA room...?

<有人知道这是什么吗……？既然我们在广播室里，那这东西应该跟广播有关吧。>
 <Anybody know what this is...? Must have something to do with broadcasting since we're in the PA room.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
执行管理者，这看起来是某种人工通讯总机。
 This appears to be a form of manual communication switchboard, Executive Manager.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
通讯总机是什么？
 What's a communication switchboard?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
一种用来管理和连接电话线路的装置。
 A device used to manage and connect circuits of telephones.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
我从没见过这种东西……所以以前的电话都得经过这个才能接通？
 I've never seen anything like this... So phones used to have to go through these to connect?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
如今这类装置大多已经不再使用了。老实说，我自己也很久没见过了。以前在……CCC，也就是指挥控制中心，倒是有过类似的装置。
 These have mostly gone out of use nowadays. I've not seen one in a long time myself, in fact. Used to have a similar device back in... the CCC, or the Command and Control Center.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
只要线路完好，经由人工总机的有线连接能提供远比无线更稳定的连接，这意味着即便在信号干扰器等装置造成的不利通讯条件下，它也能维持运作能力。
 Wired access via the manual switchboard allows for a much more stable connection as long as the wires are intact, meaning that it maintains operational capacity even in adverse communication conditions caused by devices such as signal jammers.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
正是如此。这也解释了它为何能在军事领域中沿用至今。
 Precisely. Which explains its longevity in the military context.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
不过要处理那一大片错综复杂的线路，对我手下的人来说，向来是个头疼的活儿……
 Though dealing with the wide network of wires was always a headache for my men...
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
这些管子沿墙排列的样子，让人联想起一台巨大的管风琴。
 The way these tubes are lining the wall reminds me of a massive pipe organ.

虽然不知道这是用来收听的，还是用来传话的，不过……
 Though I don't know if it's for listening or relaying but...

……一想到或许有人正在窃听我说的每一句话，从我看不见的地方对我发号施令……一股怪异的战栗，就从胃底涌了上来。
 ... imagining that someone might be listening in on my every word, giving me commands from where I can't see... a strange trepidation gurgles from the pit of my stomach.

看来，视线并不受限于视觉本身。
 The gaze is not beholden to the limitations of the sight, it seems.

几只鸟躺在一根长长的、喇叭状的管子下方。
 Several birds lie beneath a long, trumpet-shaped tube.

<color=#cf0000>不……不明白……你们绝不能明白……</color>
 <color=#cf0000>No... don't understand it... you mustn't understand...</color>

当我拾起其中一只鸟时，那声音戛然而止。
 When I pick up one of the birds, the voice cuts off.

获得死鸟。
 Obtained Dead Bird.

在几缕阳光之间，有什么东西闪着微光。
 Something glints between the shafts of sunlight.

默尔索取出了那件闪光的物体。是一台老式录音机。
 Meursault pulled out the glinting object. It's an old recorder.

……是我的错觉，还是这件外套在变小？
 ... Is it just me, or is this coat shrinking?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<你这么一说……>
 <Now that you mention it...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
看上那双袜子了？
 Taken a liking to those socks?
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
袜、袜子？这是件外套啊！
 S-Socks? This is a coat!
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
……？那是在四楼顾客中相当受欢迎的一种袜子。只要穿上就行的那种。
 ...? Those are socks that have become quite popular among the customers on the fourth floor. The kind you can put on simply by wearing them.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
功能性袜子。不用弯腰费劲，直接一套就行。
 Functional socks. One merely slips them on without having to go through the trouble of bending over.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
哦？有意思。那么，能不能把这双袜子也算作额外报酬呢？
 Oh? Intriguing. In that case, could you include these socks as additional compensation?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<奥、奥提斯……？>
 <O-Outis...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
即便是贵宾顾客，这也……
 Even for a VIP customer, these are...
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
我或许可以被说服，把打听到的关于那群披着皮革的赤红者混蛋的情报透露给你们。当然，分文不取。
 I may be persuaded to pass on any intel I learn about those hide-clad Rouge bastards. Free of charge, of course.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
唔……既然是这样的条件，那好吧。我可以割爱。
 Hmm... if that's the arrangement, then yes. I can part with them.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
拿去吧。
 Take them.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
奥提斯一脸得意地指了指那双袜子……默尔索便将它收了起来。
 Looking quite pleased with herself, Outis pointed to the socks... and Meursault collected them.

上面写着[折纸收藏系列 第92号，共5件之3。某人的坠落，升华为叠加态的时间。]
 It says [Origami CollectioN° 92, 3 of 5. Someone's fall sublimated into superpositioned time.]

上面写着[折纸收藏系列 第92号，共5件之4。]
其实和第一件看起来并没有太大不同。
 It says [Origami CollectioN° 92, 4 of 5.]
Doesn't look very different from the first one, actually.

[折纸收藏系列 第92号，共5件之2。]
 [Origami CollectioN ° 92, 2 of 5.]

<对面那些至少每一件之间还有点小变化，可这几件……说实话，这个“收藏系列”里的每一件在我看来都长得一模一样。>
 <The ones on the other side at least made small changes between each iteration, but these ones are... Honestly, everything in this "collection" looks the same to me.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
哦，对了……！我记得学过，有些版画和雕塑本来就是打算制作多份一模一样的复制品，只是给每一“份”编上不同的编号来加以区分。
 Oh, right...! I remember learning about how some prints and sculptures are made with creating multiple identical copies in mind, only giving a different number to each "iteration" to distinguish them.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
而且，即使每一件彼此之间几乎无法区分，它们的价值也可能会因编号不同而有所差异。
 And even though each piece is pretty much indistinguishable from one another, their value might vary depending on the number they're given.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
说不定我们眼前的这些其实就是这样。也许每一份之间，真的没有任何差别。
 That might be what we're looking at here, actually. Maybe there really isn't any difference between each iteration.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
这种能穿透表面标签、直击事物本质的视线……绝非寻常人类能够察觉到如此细微的差别。不愧是我们的执行管理者！
 The gaze that pierces an object straight down to its essence, unswayed by its surface-level label... No common person could have noticed such a subtle detail. I expected no less of our Executive Manager!
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<……这些东西在大多数人看来大概都长得一样吧……>
 <... These probably look the same to most people, though...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
上面写着[过季 / Prêt-à-porter]
 It says [Off-Season / Prêt-à-porter]

上面写着[过季 / Prêt-à-porter]。
有些价格标签被贴纸盖住了。想必是在打折。
 It says [Off-Season / Prêt-à-porter].
Some price tags have been taped over. Must be on sale.

<咦，你看这些标签。为什么这些衣服比别的贵？>
 <Huh, look at the tags. Why are these clothes more expensive than the others?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
那是因为您正在看的这片展示区，陈列的是本季的Prêt-à-porter单品。
 That is because the display you are looking at is for this season's Prêt-à-porter items.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<Prêt-à-porter？>
 <Prêt-à-porter?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
它指的是成批制作、可直接穿着的成衣；尤其特指其中品质与声望更高的那一类。
 It refers to made-to-stock, ready-to-wear items; those of higher quality and prestige, in particular.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<既尊贵又能直接穿，是吧……>
 <Prestige but ready-to-wear, huh...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我想着默尔索的解释，凑近仔细看了看……但还是不太明白这些衣服到底尊贵、优质在哪儿……
 I take a closer look with Meursault's explanation in mind... But I'm not entirely sure what's supposed to be so prestige and quality about these...

这张沙发亮得让人有点不安。像坐普通沙发那样瘫下去试了试，可它绷得太紧，几乎感觉不到自己是坐着的……
 This couch is disturbingly shiny. Tried slumping down on it as one would on a normal couch, but it's so taut that it doesn't even feel like I'm sitting...

获得了几颗藏在沙发缝隙里的眼球。
 Obtained some eyeballs that were hidden between the cracks in the couch.

<color=#ebcaa2>……你可真是只勤劳的小蜜蜂啊？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>... Aren't you a busy bee?</color>

那个声音把我拽回了现实，我才意识到自己正贪婪地在收银抽屉里摸来摸去。
 The voice snaps me back to reality, and I realize I've been greedily pawing at the inside of the cash drawer.

<color=#ebcaa2>要是眼球紧张成这样……你怎么不去帮那些人体模特“退场”呢？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>If you're that strapped for eyeballs... Why don't you go help the Mannequins exit the stage?</color>

她话里那丝若有若无的轻蔑让我不寒而栗，我猛地关上收银机，匆匆离开了现场。
 Shuddering at the subtle contempt in her voice, I slam the cash register shut and quickly leave the scene.

我是不是只是在盲目地翻找，指望撞上什么好运气……？
 Am I just blindly rummaging through these in hopes of finding a stroke of luck...?
[미사용] 빈약해 보이는 조명이다. 모빌 같기도 하다.

缠绕在人偶身上的布条发出微弱的绷紧声。
 Cloth straps wrapped around the figure make a faint straining noise.

……它刚才是不是笑了？大概只是看错了……
 ... Did it just smile? Probably just seeing things...

说明上把这件叫“正装”，但看起来更像是拘束衣。
 The description calls this a "formal suit", but it looks more like a straitjacket.

那双眼窝空洞的黑暗深处，似乎有什么东西正注视着这边……
 Something's watching from the dark hollows of its eye sockets...

等等，表情变了……一股莫名的恐惧爬上了脊背。
 Wait, the expression changed... A nameless terror crawls up my spine.

像那样遮住面部，如今是流行款式吗……？
 Is it in fashion to cover the face like that...?

这件服装名为[La Première Superposition]。
与这里其他衣物不同，它的袖子上只挂着一个坠饰。价格也更便宜。想必是展示中那件签名系列的“平价”版本。
 This outfit is called [La Première Superposition].
Unlike the other articles of clothing here, this one has just one dangly bit on its arm. It's cheaper, too. It must be a more "affordable" version of the Signature collection on display.

布料后面似乎有什么东西在呼吸……
 Something's breathing from behind the fabric...

收银台那边的漆黑者穿着和这件很相似的衣服。
 The Noirs at the checkout counter are wearing something similar to this outfit.

[La Troisieme Superposition。
将披风、双排扣长外套与夹克巧妙融合为一体的迷人之作。本季系列中尊贵等级最高的单品。
具体价格与预订请前往接待台咨询。]
 [La Troisieme Superposition. 
A fascinating blend of cape, frock coat, and jacket in a all-in-one integration. Highest prestige in this Season's collection.
Please visit the reception desk for pricing and reservations.]

……看来这件衣服比外表看起来要更贵、更稀有。
 ... Looks like the outfit is pricier and rarer than it looks.

[La Troisieme Superposition。
将披风、双排扣长外套与夹克巧妙融合为一体的迷人之作。本季系列中尊贵等级最高的单品。
具体价格与预订请前往接待台咨询。]
 [La Troisieme Superposition. 
A fascinating blend of cape, frock coat, and jacket in a all-in-one integration. Highest prestige in this Season's collection.
Please visit the reception desk for pricing and reservations.]

[Prêt-à-porter。金丝含量较上一季提升150%！]
 [Prêt-à-porter. Contains 150% of the Golden Yarn compared to the Last Season's!]

仔细一盘查才发现，这里面所谓的“金丝”含量其实只有0.00015%。看起来根本没有多到值得写在广告上的地步。
 Upon closer inspection, I notice that it contains only 0.00015% of the so-called "Golden Yarn." Doesn't seem anywhere near significant enough to warrant putting that on the advertisement.

这么说的话，上一季的产品岂不是只有0.0001%的金丝……？
 Doesn't this mean that the last season's products had only 0.0001% Golden Yarn...?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
……我敢打赌，U公司出的鲸鱼薯片里的鲸鱼含量都比这里的金丝含量高。
 ... I'm willing to bet that Whale chips from U Corp. have more Whale in them than this has Golden Yarn.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
一个摆满眼镜的展示柜。不过不太清楚这些眼镜该怎么戴。
 A display case full of glasses. Not sure how I'd go about wearing them, however.
……这确实是眼镜吧……？展示台上方的标签上写的的确是“眼镜”…… ... These are glasses, right...? The label above the display does say "glasses"...

展示台上摆着几副样式怪异地普通、显得格格不入的眼镜和墨镜。其中有几副看起来很像格里高尔的眼镜。
 On display are bizarrely normal-looking pairs of glasses and sunglasses that look distinctly out of place. Some of these look like Gregor's glasses.

几副样式怪异地普通、在这儿显得格格不入的眼镜和墨镜。普通得几乎有点令人意外。
 Bizarrely normal-looking pairs of glasses and sunglasses that look out of place here. Surprisingly mundane, almost.

一件凳子和抽屉柜的结合体……凳屉。不过看起来两边都没当好。
 A combination of a stool and a drawer... A strawer. Looks like it fails at being either, though.

一件凳子和抽屉柜的结合体……凳屉。在它的抽屉里找到了一把被人遗忘的眼球。
 A combination of a stool and a drawer... A strawer. Found a handful of eyeballs in its drawer that somebody forgot.

一件凳子和抽屉柜的结合体……凳屉。在它的抽屉里找到了一把被人遗忘的眼球……才没有。不过让钟表抱抱希望也无妨。 A combination of a stool and a drawer... A strawer. Found a handful of eyeballs in its drawer that somebody forgot... not. A clock can hope, though.

啊……你们回来了。我们一直在等你们。
 Ah... You've returned. We've been waiting for you.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
你们把我们的口信转达给四楼的漆黑者了吗？
 Did you relay our message to the Noirs on the fourth floor?
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
转达了。
 We did.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
万分感谢……他们对此有什么说法吗？
 Much appreciated... Did they have anything to say about it?
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
四楼的漆黑者希望我们把这个转交给你们。
 The Noirs on the fourth floor wanted us to deliver this to you.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
在递上那张字条的同时，我们把从四楼打听到的消息也转告给了他们，两位漆黑者焦虑地听着。
 Along with the note, we relayed what we learned from the fourth floor as the two Noirs listened anxiously.

被自己的“声音”抛弃的赤红者，正在奢华厅里密谋孕育一个新的“声音”……？
 Le Rouge, abandoned by their Voice, is conspiring within the Luxury Hall to give life to a new Voice...?
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
……原来如此……如果我们还想阻止他们那险恶的计划得逞，就需要一件用“尖钉”和金色布料制成的器物。
 ... I see... And an implement made of "Nail" and Golden Fabric is needed if we're to have any hope of stopping their vile plan from coming to fruition.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
如果楼上那位尊贵人物所说属实，那我们的方向就很清楚了。……我们可以趁那个新“声音”尚未诞生之际将其撕碎，从而把奢华厅夺为漆黑者所有。
 If it really is as the noble one on the upper floor says, then our path forward is clear. ... We can claim the Luxury Hall as Le Noir's by tearing apart that new "Voice" of theirs before it is born.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
……真不想再开口麻烦你们，可我们又一次需要各位怪人的帮助了。
 ... I hate to ask again, but we are in need of your assistance once again, strangers.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
<那个……反正我们的目标看起来是一致的。我们需要二楼的那件奢华服装，才能获准进入五楼。>
 <Well... our goals seem to align anyway. We need those Luxury clothes from the second floor to be admitted to the fifth floor.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我们的目标是一致的。
 Our goals align.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
*叹气* 万分感激。
 *sigh* Much obliged.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
我们对金色布料倒也不算完全陌生——我们的一些作品里甚至用过，不过得委托改衣师帮忙制作。
 We're not entirely unfamiliar with the Golden Fabric—we've even used it for some of our works, though we had to commission the Alterationist for it.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
不过棘手的是那金色线束……我完全不知道那东西是从哪儿弄来的。
 The tricky part's going to be the Golden Skein, though... I have no idea where that's sourced from.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
根据字条上的配方……我们或许能从某种蚕茧里弄到它。
 According to the recipe on the note... we might be able to get it from some kind of cocoon.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
那就是说你们需要金色蚕茧才能得到金色线束了。法兰绒，人们通常都是从哪儿弄到蚕茧的？
 That means you're going to need the Golden Cocoon to obtain the Golden Skein. Flannel, where do people usually come by the cocoons?
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
蚕茧可以在地下一层找到……咦。是地下楼层吗？
 The cocoon can be found on B1... Huh. The basement floors?
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
地下一层……！原来如此，这趟旅程会把你们带到地下楼层去。那我猜你们也得跟地下二层的楼层经理打交道了……这也正好解答了金色线束该如何纺成的问题。
 B1F...! I see, this journey will bring you to the subterranean floors. Then I presume you will be dealing with B2's Floor Manager as well... which answers the question concerning how the Golden Skein is to be spun.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
呃……下面危险吗？
 Uh... Is it dangerous down there?
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text: 倒也算不上危险，不过……那氛围确实相当独特。 Not dangerous per se, but... certainly unique in its atmosphere.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text: 我们以前是去过下面几次，没错。不过也只是为了抢先认领一些原始纤维而已……那地方，嗯，怎么说呢，相当原始。 We have been down there a few times before, yes. But only to lay an early claim to the raw fibers... That place is, hm, you see, quite primal.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
总之，我建议你们拿到蚕茧后再去探索一下地下二层。地下二层的楼层经理是漆黑者的老搭档了，所以只要带上品鉴证书，一切应该都能顺利进行。
 Anyway, I suggest you explore B2 once you acquire the cocoon. B2's Floor Manager is a long-time collaborator of the Noirs, so I'm sure it'll all go smoothly as long as you bring the Authenticity Certificate with you.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
至于那“尖钉”……一根长骨应该就够了，可是……哪一根呢？我们得好好想想。
 As for the "Nail"... A long piece of bone should do, but... which one? We'll have to think about it.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
依我看，是时候好好利用一下这层楼另一头那个恶心的赤红者了。我一直觉得，她的脊柱拿来当长钉正合适。
 I say it's about time we made use of that revolting Rouge on the other end of this floor. I've always thought her spinal cord would come in useful as a long nail.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
这两样东西我们都没有，也从未见过类似的东西。
 Neither is in our possession, nor have we seen anything like it before.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
这将会是一趟相当曲折的旅程，各个部件散落在不同的楼层里。
 It's going to be a very roundabout journey, with all the pieces scattered throughout the floors.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
当然了，我们一定会用眼球给你们丰厚的报酬。
 And of course, we will be sure to compensate you handsomely with eyeballs.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
<等我们完成他们的任务之后，你能不能也顺便问问，他们愿不愿意让我们拿二楼的衣服，好让我们能上五楼？>
