 <Can you also ask them, once we're done carrying out their tasks, if they'll let us have some clothes from the second floor so we can get onto the fifth?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
执行管理者想问问你们二位，这次合作能否确保我们获准进入五楼。
 The Executive Manager would like to ask the two of you if this collaboration would secure us access to the fifth floor.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
很遗憾，这个我没法保证，不过……我保证漆黑者会永远感激你们。
 I can't guarantee that, unfortunately, but... I promise that you will have Le Noir's eternal gratitude.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
赐予你们那类特权不在我的权限范围之内，但至少，我可以为这次合作再给你们写一份品鉴证书。
 It is not within my authority to grant you anything of the like, but I can write you another Authenticity Certificate for this collaboration, at the very least.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
我一定会动用我所有的人脉，尽力在其他漆黑者面前替你们美言几句。
 I'll be sure to pull all the strings I have and put in as good a word as I can to the other Noirs.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
<……这样就够了。我们走吧。>
 <... Good enough for me. Let's go.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
完成了。这块金色布料和它的光辉，你们可以带走了。
 It's done. You may take this Golden Fabric and its brilliance with you.
texts.speaker:
安妮特
 Annette

texts.text:
<那现在……我们只需要那根“尖钉”就能凑齐了。>
 <And now...we just need the "Nail" to complete this.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
据漆黑者员工所说，那位赤红者商贩的……脊柱……应该能当作一根像样的长钉。
 According to the Noir employees, the Rouge vendor's... spinal cord... would make a decent long nail.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<唔……好吧，那我们就去看看她的情况吧。>
 <Hm... Well, let's go check up on her, then.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
应该尽快把这束线拿去改衣店。
 Should probably get this skein to the Alteration Shop as soon as possible.

应该去拜访一下那位赤红者商贩。
 Should probably visit the Rouge vendor.

<……我觉得她的扭曲正在恶化……>
 <... I think her Distortion's getting worse...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<我能听到里面有什么声音。在喃喃自语……>
 <I can hear something from the inside. Muttering...>
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text: 见证你所有选择的最终结晶吧。一件件事情毫无章法地接连发生，只是模糊地不断叠加，直到某一天，它终于发生了。 Witness the culmination of your choices. Events follow events without rhyme or reason in a vaguely-defined series of additions until, one day, it happens.

<color=#ebcaa2>这位一直在把自己硬塞进一件不合身的衣服里。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>This one's been squeezing herself into an ill-fitting outfit.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>又或者，她只是如今才终于弄清了自己确切的尺寸？熟悉是种强大的东西……它甚至能让人习惯最不舒服的衣服。</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Or maybe she's only now learned of her exact measurements? Familiarity's a powerful thing... It can acclimatize you to even the most uncomfortable of outfits.</color>

<color=#ebcaa2>还记得吗，ma puce？我们约会那次穿的那条不合身的绿裙子。还记得我抱怨了多久吗？</color>
 <color=#ebcaa2>Remember, ma puce? The ill-fitting green dress I wore to our date. Remember how long I complained?</color>

从那位已经停止动弹的赤红者身上，撕下了她的脊柱。
 Ripped the spine off the Rouge who'd stopped moving.

呃……没想到拔一根脊柱这么费劲。
 Ugh... didn't know it was this hard to remove a spine.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
……所以，这就是他们所说的“尖钉”？从尸体上摘下的一根脊柱？
 ... So, this is what they meant by "nail"? A spine removed from a corpse?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text: 它被定义为尖钉。 It is defined as a nail.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
我们把金色布料裹在了从那位赤红者身上取下的尖钉上。
 We draped the Golden Fabric around the nail we took from the Rouge.

<这就是那把传说中，无论布料如何编织都能刺穿的武器……>
 <So this is the legendary weapon capable of piercing any fabric, no matter its weave...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
剪刀咔嚓咔嚓的声音停了下来。
 The snip-snip of the scissors have gone silent.

漆黑者的尸体。就连他们曾经引以为傲的布料，也没能救他们于这般命运。
 The corpse of a Noir. Even the fabric they took such pride in couldn't save them from this fate.

一个[Prêt-à-porter]展示架。
 A [Prêt-à-porter] display rack.

盯着它看太久，不知为何会让人感到疲惫。
 Staring at it for too long is somehow exhausting.

上面写着[折纸收藏系列 第92号，共5件之2。某人的坠落，升华为叠加态的时间。]
 It says [Origami CollectioN° 92, 2 of 5. Someone's fall sublimated into superpositioned time.]

正如奥提斯所说的那种通讯总机。
 A communication switchboard, as described by Outis.

那金色的光……你们真的做到了……
 That golden glow... You've really done it...
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
光说一句“谢谢”，实在没法表达我们的感激之情，所以我们就不客套了，直接说重点吧。
 A mere "thank you" couldn't possibly express our gratitude, so we'll dispense with the formalities and get straight to the point.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text: 我们漆黑者绝不会忘记各位为我们的事业做出的巨大贡献。请各位放心，亲爱的顾客们，你们的名字将永远铭刻在我们的贵宾名单上。 We Noirs will never forget the tremendous contribution you have made in service of our cause. Rest assured, your names will be forever etched on our VIP list, dear customers.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
连我自己都从没踏进过奢华厅一步。我们路过那层楼的时候能远远看上一眼，但他们从没让我们看过里面的样子。
 Even I have never set foot in the Luxury Hall. I could look at it from a distance when we stopped by that floor, but they've never let us see what's inside.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
想要获准进入的人，得满足一些极其严苛的资格才行……
 Whoever wants admittance is going to need to meet some stringent qualifications...
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
……说来惭愧，这个任务大概只有像各位这样不受各楼层规矩束缚的顾客才能完成了。
 ... Which... I'm sorry to say, is a task that only customers like yourselves, who are unbound by the rules of each Floor, can complete.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
那些失去了“声音”的人，以为自己能给自己织出一个新的来……？荒唐至极。他们真是愚昧又自负，至死都不知悔改。
 Those bereaved of the Voice believe they can weave themselves a new one, do they...? Preposterous. Ignorant and presumptuous to the bitter end, they are.
texts.speaker:
毛毡
 Felt

texts.text:
做好准备，前往奢华厅吧。
 Make your preparations, and head to the Luxury Hall.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
不管他们在密谋什么……都要彻底粉碎他们的抵抗，让他们连再动这种念头都不敢。
 Whatever it is they're planning... Utterly crush their resistance so that they may never even dream of attempting such a thing again.
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
唯有如此，永恒才会降临西西弗百货……由金色树脂凝聚在一起的永恒……
 Only then shall eternity come to the Grand Magasin... Held together by the Golden Resin...
texts.speaker:
法兰绒
 Flannel

texts.text:
听……那颤颤颤颤音……！
 Heeeeaaaar.... it warbling...!
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
楼层经理从底座上站了起来。是时候结束这一切了。
 The Floor Manager rises from their pedestal. Time to end this.

！暗影战斗！
 !SHADOWED BATTLE!

安静静静静静吧……安静静静静静吧……
 Be sileeeeeeent... Be sileeeeeeent...
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
让你那愚蠢的欲望……安息吧……
 Put your foolish desires... to rest...
texts.speaker:
三楼楼层经理
 3F Floor Manager

texts.text:
<该死，还以为躲过去了。>
 <Damn, thought we dodged that.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
那个敌人在多个方面都很棘手……速度是一回事，但它还有一种诡异的能力，能在最后一刻转向，跟上默尔索的躲避动作。
 That enemy presents difficulties on multiple fronts... Its speed is one thing, but it has the uncanny ability to swerve at the last minute to follow Meursault's attempt to evade.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
我建议利用场地中的障碍物，或者采取更难以预测的躲避动作。
 I recommend using the environmental obstacles or employing more unpredictable evasive maneuvers.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<你觉得那样管用吗……？>
 <Do you think that'll work...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我会按您的指示尝试躲避。
 I will attempt to evade as you command.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<……对啊……我没把握的部分，恰恰就是我的指示。不过没事，我们再试一次吧。>
 <... Yeah... my command's the part where I'm not so confident about. But fine, let's try this again.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<哇。那玩意儿爆炸得比我预想的要早得多。>
 <Whoa. That thing blew up much sooner than I'd expected.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
一旦它开始颤动，我们就得赶紧撤离。
 We'll have to move away as soon as it begins to tremble.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
下次尽量再警觉一点。
 Try to stay more alert next time.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
明白了。
 It will be done.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……那声音可真不怎么讨喜。
 ... That wasn't a very pleasant noise.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
执行管理者，您没受伤吧？
 Are you unhurt, Executive Manager?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
<那声音把我吓得不轻，不过……除此之外没受伤。>
 <I'm a bit rattled by the noise, but... otherwise unhurt.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<倒是默尔索……他的脑袋爆炸了。>
 <Meursault, on the other hand... got his head exploded.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
感觉像是有什么东西在缓缓充满、膨胀我的脑袋。
 It felt as though something were slowly filling and inflating my head.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
听着默尔索平静地描述那可怕的死法，辛克莱挠了挠后脑勺，尴尬地插了句话。
 Hearing Meursault's placid description of that horrible death, Sinclair scratched the back of his head and awkwardly chimed in.

啊……真庆幸我没经历那个。谢谢你提醒我堵上耳朵，奥提斯小姐。
 Ah... I'm glad I didn't have to go through that. Thanks for telling me to plug my ears, Miss Outis.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<那就好。那……我们先休息五分钟，再重新出发吧。>
 <That's good. Then... Let's take five and head out again.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……那东西一接触到他，就把他撕成了两半。
 ... That thing ripped him in half the moment they came into contact.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:

 Ooh... Voice, help me... Was becoming blinded and nailed not enough? Must I now be killed by the hands of an assailant who refuses me even the courtesy of telling me what I'm dying for?
